discovery_notes: B401 follow-up 8 of B044 (DLP 2020-2021), 28 web searches, all search_snippet. New: CM Pascal & Cruella 2020 (3020), CM Mad Hatter & Alice 2021 (3021), La Petite Sirene Pin Trading Event 18 Sep 2021 (seven pins, LE 425 vs 400), first Pin Trading Time 5 Feb 2020 Dumbo three (LE 400), Stitch Noel OE 29 Mar 2021, August 2020 Gepetto/Jiminy/Bullseye and two castle pins (castle lead released). Jungle Festival 21 Aug 2021 corroborated as Pin Trading Day. Float names, RotJ four, Dalmatians LE three still missing.
